akka_intro.text: Listen. Cold panels push higher voltage. The coldest sunrise of the year is the most dangerous moment for your inverter. Not the hottest noon.

akka_rule.text: Take the coldest morning on record. Work out each panel's voltage there. Divide the inverter's maximum by that, and always round down.

akka_heat.text: Heat does the opposite. On a hot afternoon the voltage sags. Too few panels and the inverter just falls asleep.
